items.title: Special termination right (price increase) must reach provider
items.quote: Ihre Kündigung muss uns vor diesem Tag erreichen.
items.computation: The letter grants a special termination right (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG) tied to the price change effective 01.05.2025: 'Sie können den Vertrag ohne Einhaltung einer Frist zum 01.05.2025 kündigen'. It then states the cancellation must reach the provider before that day, i.e. before 01.05.2025. The last day on which it can still arrive is therefore 30.04.2025. This is a private contractual deadline (not a court/authority period), so no weekend/holiday extension applies; notice periods for cancelling a contract are not moved even if the last day is a weekend/holiday (here 30.04.2025 is a Wednesday, so no issue arises anyway).
